controls.label: absent time allows out of range index

limitations: Valid ordered unique-key logical position and rate maps, successful allocation, and diagnostic callbacks returning normally. Physical hybrid map representation, allocator/unwind behavior and diagnostic side effects are excluded.
Timestamp is an unchanged three-word payload with nonzero date word when present; no calendar validation or timestamp generation is claimed.
Owned OracleIndex and NotionalRange faults mark native panic premises and are not native error ABI. Earlier position mutations are not rolled back; native unwinding is outside the contract.

Full per-user helper only; outer parallel collection, cross-user settlement, persistence, event delivery and balance redistribution are excluded. No captured target execution/emulation or live chain operations.
